title: Ἀποτελεσματικά, Apotelesmatica (Pseudo-Manetho); «Апотелесматика»
author: Pseudo-Manetho (composite)
date: c. 1st/2nd–4th c. CE (books of different dates)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Манефон' names the 6-book work but lists no translation; none found.
value: The largest surviving Greek astrological poem. A source for the social history of Roman Egypt (professions, slaves, marriage, deviance) and for imperial verse technique. Used by historians of science and of Roman society.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Technical but repetitive. Lightfoot's English gives cross-checking.
